headline: Broad Rally Lifts Book +2.9%, Miners Lead
summary: Strong green day driven by IREN and AMD, but most of that strength is bounce off deep drawdowns rather than confirmed trend — AVGO and MSFT are still double-digit underwater despite today's pop. Discipline held: every low-float runner alert was correctly ignored.
watch: WBX at $5.58 vs. $4.60 stop — spec stub exits fully on any close below that level, watch it into the close.
AAPL at $312.71 sits between both triggers: $300 stop guards any new buy, queued $250 add only fires on a confirmed daily close ≥$317.
PANW RSI must print ≤70 before any new position there is allowed.
CRWD needs an RSI pullback to ≤60 before buying — not there yet.
GEV base setup is coiling — wait for volume confirmation before entering, don't buy the coil blind.
ANET setup is ready but volume isn't confirming — no entry until volume shows up.
recap: Book +2.90% to $12,525 — best day in a while, broad participation across holdings.
IREN +14.8% today but still -27.2% P/L with RSI only 39.4 — this is a bounce, not yet a confirmed trend reversal.
AMD +7.0% pushed P/L to +10.2%, your best performer, RSI 57.4 — healthy, not extended.
AVGO +3.9% re-hit its RSI≥45 watchpoint four separate times today but remains -10.8% P/L — an underwater winner, not a green light for new risk.
NEE watchpoint fired BUY — starter entry cleared per plan; MSFT lagged -0.9% and stays the weakest holding at -11.6% P/L.
GEV and ANET flagged high-conviction; SEER/PEW/YDES/WRAP runner-ignition alerts on extended microcaps were all correctly avoided — no FOMO chasing.
